description: Content pack for the observability stack — dashboards, contracts and alert rules. Ships the platform tier only, the content of a particular installation is handed in through values, so the chart can be vendored or pulled from a registry as it is. Umbrella chart for the observability storage core (VictoriaMetrics / VictoriaLogs / VictoriaTraces, metrics contracts, disk autoscaling, deadman switch)
